items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Basie's a very lonely man on his band stand after having played with Lester Young and Herschel and Doug Clayton and Harry Edison and Jack Washington.

ctx.x: And he doesn't lead his own band, he sees very bad advice from management, we won't say any names, that guide his destiny, and Basie hasn't actively been a

leader for many years.
Basie's a very lonely man on his band stand after having played with Lester Young and Herschel and Doug Clayton and Harry Edison and Jack Washington. (Inaudible).
Jack died the same month as Sam Cooke. (Inaudible)
Basie is just going through the motions. The last time he was here in June, I introduced his band, I was paid to introduce him and present him with a painting that a fellow made, which I played with him in '45, '46, and '47, and it's a disgrace that he would take that band around…
couldn't play, all the public would know it. Hey, that saxophone player is not with it; nowadays, who knows.
